## 研究口径

同一已验收494期快照中，排除已研究94期回撤窗口。最早10期固定作为预热，
其余390期为本轮评价范围：回撤窗口前305期、窗口后85期，分别汇报。
这仍是已知历史资料上的规则迁移检验，不称为未见样本或前瞻验证。
每10个连续历史期冻结一次 HANDICAP 模型，回撤窗口也计入更新时钟，但不计入本轮评价；此前历史包括合法准入的回撤期，不能使用目标或未来标签。
模型格子、50%累计＋50%最近三期、各层收缩、SP1.3与每期1024元均保持此前参数。
标签时点沿用最后场次＋48小时的诊断代理，不证明真实赛前可用性。

原概率 PROB、旧 SOFT（每个第三赛果将组合购买分数乘0.5）、旧 HARD（只允许Top2）、
旧 FULL（128种Top2买齐）均保留25%真实累计覆盖与256元单组上限。
另外冻结原 PROB 选中的组和票数，对比第三赛果减半转给第二赛果与刚性Top2；后者在配套报告执行。
前一类可重新选组并留现金，后一类隔离同投入购买顺序的影响，不混为同一规则。
所有参数事先固定；不根据本轮表现选门槛、种子或权重。0.65只在票级结算一次。

```{r}
library(dplyr);library(tidyr);library(readr);library(ggplot2)
stopifnot(!is.null(params$study),!is.null(params$output),!is.null(params$python))
reticulate::use_python(params$python,required=TRUE)
files<-c('diagnostic_verified_csv','diagnostic_verified_rds','draw_refresh','draw_handicap_refresh','n7_top2_coverage','n7_probability_replay','n7_sleeve_tables','n7_joint_sleeves','n7_capital_depth',
 'n7_capital_portfolio','n7_core_opportunity','n7_sweet_union','n7_sp_filter','n7_quality_settlement',
 'strategy_diagnostic_probabilities','strategy_handicap_diagnostic','fundamentals_equity_curves',
 'n7_sweet_union_summary','n7_recent_structure')
files<-paste0('r/',files,'.R');for(f in files)source(f)
files<-c(files,'quarto/177_top2_outside_validation.qmd','config/top2_outside_validation.json')
code<-setNames(as.list(vapply(files,digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')),files)
core<-reticulate::import('src.temporal_learning.core');blocks_api<-reticulate::import('src.temporal_learning.frozen_blocks')
prov<-reticulate::import('src.temporal_learning.provenance');pathlib<-reticulate::import('pathlib')
closure<-prov$implementation_closure(pathlib$Path(getwd()),
 c('src.draw_refresh_context','src.probability_foundation_draw','src.fundamentals_n7_baseline','src.strategy_diagnostic_inputs'),distributions=c('numpy','pandas'))
window<-jsonlite::fromJSON('config/top2_outside_validation.json')
if(!identical(params$catalog_sha256,window$catalog_sha256))stop('Configured catalog identity mismatch')
s<-params$study;o<-params$output
# Exclusive run directory: never overwrite an earlier frozen research package.
stopifnot(!dir.exists(o),dir.create(o,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE))
input_api<-reticulate::import('src.strategy_diagnostic_inputs')
catpath<-file.path(s,'settlement-inputs/catalog.json')
catbytes<-readBin(catpath,'raw',n=file.info(catpath)$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(catbytes,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==params$catalog_sha256)
catlg<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(catbytes))
er<-jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(s,'evaluation/receipt.json'))
ar<-jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(s,'current-settlement/receipt.json'))
strategy_verify_diagnostic_inputs(file.path(s,'evaluation'),er$files,c('results.csv','funded.csv'))
strategy_verify_diagnostic_inputs(file.path(s,'current-settlement'),ar$files,c('fixture-audit.csv','ranks.csv'))
stopifnot(window$source_results_sha256==er$files[['results.csv']])
ids<-window$issues
stopifnot(length(ids)==390,!any(ids %in% window$excluded_drawdown_issues),!any(ids %in% window$warmup_issues))
input<-jsonlite::fromJSON(input_api$read_diagnostic_epoch_fixtures(catpath,params$catalog_sha256))
fx<-as_tibble(input$rows)
fixtures<-split(fx,fx$issue)
targets<-fx |> filter(!issue %in% window$warmup_issues) |> transmute(issue_code=issue,fixture_decision_ts)
blocks<-blocks_api$frozen_block_schedule(reticulate::r_to_py(as.data.frame(targets)),cadence=as.integer(window$cadence))
stopifnot(length(blocks)==49)
sources<-list(catalog=params$catalog_sha256,fixture_audit=ar$files[['fixture-audit.csv']],
 evaluation_results=er$files[['results.csv']],r_code=digest::digest(code,algo='sha256'))
models<-list();cells<-list()
plans<-funded<-predictions<-bindings<-list()
jsonlite::write_json(blocks,file.path(o,'blocks.json'),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
for(block in blocks) {
 cutoff<-core$Cutoff$decision_epoch(block$fit_issue,block$fit_cutoff_ts)
 # Only prior labels cross the shared reader; earlier blocks already have
 # immutable model/ticket replays on disk before later historical labels open.
 history_json<-reticulate::import('src.draw_refresh_context')$draw_refresh_prior_history_json(
  jsonlite::toJSON(fx,dataframe='rows',auto_unbox=TRUE,digits=NA),
  jsonlite::toJSON(block,auto_unbox=TRUE,digits=NA),
  label_path=file.path(s,'current-settlement/fixture-audit.csv'),
  label_sha256=ar$files[['fixture-audit.csv']],delay_hours=window$delay_hours)
 history<-jsonlite::fromJSON(history_json)
 model<-draw_handicap_fit(history,block,cutoff,getwd(),sources,
 window$draw_breaks,window$gap_breaks,window$long_strength,window$recent_strength,window$handicap_strength,window$handicap_recent_strength,window$delay_hours,window$recent_issues,window$minimum_ess,params$python,gap_mode='absolute',refinement_cols='handicap')
 models[[block$fit_issue]]<-model
 saveRDS(model,file.path(o,paste0('model-',block$fit_issue,'.rds')))
 cells[[block$fit_issue]]<-model$cells |> mutate(fit_issue=block$fit_issue)
 for(target in block$targets) {
 id<-target$issue
 if(!id %in% ids)next
 cutoff<-core$Cutoff$decision_epoch(id,target$cutoff_ts)
 item<-catlg$issues |> filter(issue==id)
 bundle<-jsonlite::fromJSON(input_api$read_verified_bundle_json(item$path,item$sha256),simplifyVector=FALSE)
 f<-fixtures[[id]];model<-models[[block$fit_issue]]
 for(arm in window$models) {
  z<-draw_handicap_predict(model,f,cutoff,window$alpha,getwd(),params$python)
  model_key<-paste(model$seal,window$alpha,sep=':')
  predictions[[length(predictions)+1L]]<-z |> mutate(arm=arm,fit_issue=block$fit_issue)
  updated<-n7_probability_bundle(bundle,z,bundle$cutoffs,model_key)
  prepared_modes<-n7_top2_batch(updated,bundle$cutoffs,params$python,model_key,window$gated_policies,window$third_penalty,window$target_coverage,window$group_cap_cny,window$unit_cny,window$payout_factor,window$minimum_sp)
  for(mode in window$gated_policies) {
   name<-paste(arm,mode,sep='_')
   prepared<-prepared_modes[[mode]]
   allocated<-n7_top2_allocate(prepared,bundle$cutoffs,window$seed,window$worlds,window$budget_cny,256)
   result<-list(surface=prepared$surface,pool=prepared$pool,gate=prepared$gate,
    rank_preferences=prepared$ranks,coverage_ledger=prepared$ledger,parameters=prepared$parameters,
    worlds=allocated$worlds,scenarios=allocated$scenarios,fit=allocated$fit)
   opts<-result$pool$options[result$fit$selected];amount<-sum(vapply(opts,`[[`,numeric(1),'stake'))
   for(opt in opts)funded[[length(funded)+1L]]<-tibble(issue=id,arm=name,seed=42501,
    sleeve_id=as.character(opt$sleeve_id),depth=opt$depth,copies=1,stake=opt$stake,coverage=opt$coverage)
   plans[[length(plans)+1L]]<-tibble(issue=id,arm=name,policy=name,seed=42501,model=arm,
    budget_cny=1024,stake=amount,cash=1024-amount,groups=length(opts),status=if(amount>0)'COMPLETE' else 'NO_BET')
   replay_name<-paste0('replay-',id,'-',name,'.rds')
   saveRDS(list(result=result,fixtures=updated$expanded_pool$fixtures,cutoffs=bundle$cutoffs,
    model_identity=model_key,block=block),file.path(o,replay_name),compress='gzip')
   bindings[[paste(id,name)]]<-list(issue=id,arm=name,replay=replay_name,
    replay_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(o,replay_name),algo='sha256'),source_bundle=item$sha256,
    fit_model_seal=model$seal,
    cache_key=core$stable_json_hash(list(cutoff=target,block=block$seal,model=model_key,sources=sources,
     implementation=code,python=closure$closure_sha256,
     parameters=list(mode=mode,third_penalty=.5,budget=1024,target=.25,group_cap=256,minimum_sp=1.3,
      unit=2,factor=.65,seed=42501,worlds=256,handicap_strength=100,handicap_recent_strength=20))))
  }
 }
 message('Draw refresh frozen: ',id);writeLines(id,file.path(o,'progress.txt'))
}
}
saveRDS(models,file.path(o,'frozen-models.rds'))
write_csv(bind_rows(cells),file.path(o,'cells.csv'))
plans<-bind_rows(plans);funded<-bind_rows(funded);predictions<-bind_rows(predictions)
write_csv(plans,file.path(o,'frozen-plans.csv'));write_csv(funded,file.path(o,'frozen-funded.csv'))
write_csv(predictions,file.path(o,'predictions.csv'))
stopifnot(identical(code,setNames(as.list(vapply(files,digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')),files)))
jsonlite::write_json(list(sources=sources,implementation=code,python_implementation=closure,
 bindings=bindings,model_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(o,'frozen-models.rds'),algo='sha256'),
 plans_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(o,'frozen-plans.csv'),algo='sha256'),
 funded_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(o,'frozen-funded.csv'),algo='sha256'),
 predictions_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(o,'predictions.csv'),algo='sha256'),
 historical_admission=FALSE,scope=ids),file.path(o,'plans-receipt.json'),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
```

## 开封目标结果与比较

所有目标票先冻结，再计算各概率版本下的实际中奖排名。以下沿用同一场次组合的北单回款，
不能将旧概率排名直接用于新票结算。原冻结版本必须逐组复现旧账本。

```{r}
labels<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(s,'current-settlement/fixture-audit.csv'),ar$files[['fixture-audit.csv']],cols(issue='c',provider_id='c'))
old<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(s,'evaluation/results.csv'),er$files[['results.csv']],cols(issue='c')) |>
 filter(variant=='JOINT',seed==42501,budget_cny==1024)
k<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(s,'current-settlement/ranks.csv'),ar$files[['ranks.csv']],cols(issue='c',sleeve_id='c',fixture_slots='c'))
ranks<-coverage_ledgers<-list()
for(binding in bindings) {
 stopifnot(digest::digest(file=file.path(o,binding$replay),algo='sha256')==binding$replay_sha256)
 replay<-diagnostic_read_verified_rds(file.path(o,binding$replay),binding$replay_sha256);surface<-replay$result$surface
 coverage_ledgers[[length(coverage_ledgers)+1L]]<-replay$result$coverage_ledger |> mutate(issue=binding$issue,arm=binding$arm)
 for(j in seq_len(nrow(surface$prob_mat))) {
  sid<-rownames(surface$prob_mat)[j]
  group<-k |> filter(issue==binding$issue,sleeve_id==sid)
  stopifnot(nrow(group)==1)
  slots<-as.integer(strsplit(surface$summary$fixture_slots[j],'|',fixed=TRUE)[[1]])
  lf<-labels |> filter(issue==binding$issue) |> slice(match(slots,slot))
  stopifnot(nrow(lf)==7,!anyNA(lf$actual_direction),all(lf$status=='READY'))
  actual_index<-1+sum((match(lf$actual_direction,c('W','D','L'))-1)*3^(6:0))
  preferences<-replay$result$rank_preferences |> filter(sleeve_id==as.integer(sid))
  actual_pref<-preferences |> filter(state_id==actual_index)
  rank<-actual_pref$settlement_rank;purchase<-actual_pref$purchase_rank
  ix<-preferences$state_id[which(preferences$purchase_rank<=purchase)]
  ranks[[length(ranks)+1L]]<-tibble(issue=binding$issue,arm=binding$arm,sleeve_id=sid,
   actual_rank=rank,purchase_rank=purchase,actual_legal=!is.na(purchase),actual_top2=actual_pref$all_top2,
   actual_cost=2*purchase,actual_probability=surface$prob_mat[j,actual_index],
   actual_cumulative=if(is.na(purchase))NA_real_ else sum(surface$prob_mat[j,ix]),
   top128=sum(surface$prob_mat[j,surface$rank_idx[j,1:128]]),
   actual_gross_cny=group$actual_gross_cny)

 }
}
ranks<-bind_rows(ranks);coverage_ledgers<-bind_rows(coverage_ledgers)
write_csv(coverage_ledgers,file.path(o,'coverage-ledgers.csv'));rows<-groups<-list()
for(arm_name in unique(plans$arm)) {
 z<-n7_quality_settlement(plans |> filter(arm==arm_name),funded |> filter(arm==arm_name),ranks |> filter(arm==arm_name))
 rows[[arm_name]]<-z$rows;groups[[arm_name]]<-z$groups
}
rows<-bind_rows(rows) |> mutate(cash_cny=cash);groups<-bind_rows(groups)
curves<-strategy_equity_curves(rows,ids,100000);stopifnot(!any(curves$stopped))
summary<-curves |> filter(period>0) |> group_by(policy) |> summarise(issues=n(),stake=sum(funded_stake_cny),
 net=sum(funded_net_cny),roi=net/stake,hit_issues=sum(gross>0),profit_issues=sum(funded_net_cny>0),
 max_drawdown=max(drawdown_cny),minimum_equity=min(100000,equity_cny),.groups='drop')
long<-predictions |> select(issue,slot,provider_id,handicap,arm,new_W,new_D,new_L) |>
 pivot_longer(starts_with('new_'),names_prefix='new_',names_to='outcome',values_to='probability') |>
 rename(model=arm) |> left_join(labels |> select(issue,slot,provider_id,actual_outcome=actual_direction),
 by=c('issue','slot','provider_id'),relationship='many-to-one')
probability<-strategy_probability_diagnostics(long,character(),c('W','D','L'),seq(0,1,.1))
handicap<-strategy_handicap_diagnostic(long,'handicap',c('W','D','L'),seq(0,1,.1))
rank_summary<-ranks |> group_by(arm) |> summarise(groups=n(),legal_fraction=mean(actual_legal),top2_fraction=mean(actual_top2),median_rank=median(purchase_rank,na.rm=TRUE),
 rank_q75=quantile(purchase_rank,.75,na.rm=TRUE),rank_q90=quantile(purchase_rank,.9,na.rm=TRUE),within128=mean(actual_legal & actual_rank<=128),
 median_cost=median(actual_cost,na.rm=TRUE),.groups='drop')
base_rank<-ranks |> filter(arm=='HANDICAP_PROB') |> select(issue,sleeve_id,old_rank=actual_rank)
rank_changes<-ranks |> left_join(base_rank,by=c('issue','sleeve_id'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 group_by(arm) |> summarise(earlier=sum(actual_legal & actual_rank<old_rank),later=sum(actual_legal & actual_rank>old_rank),
 unreachable=sum(!actual_legal),
 rescue128=sum(actual_rank<=128 & old_rank>128),lost128=sum(actual_rank>128 & old_rank<=128),.groups='drop')
for(name in c('rows','groups','ranks','summary','curves','rank_summary','rank_changes'))write_csv(get(name),file.path(o,paste0(name,'.csv')))
write_csv(probability$summary,file.path(o,'probability-summary.csv'))
write_csv(probability$calibration,file.path(o,'calibration.csv'))
write_csv(handicap$cells,file.path(o,'handicap.csv'))
knitr::kable(summary,digits=3);knitr::kable(probability$summary,digits=4)
knitr::kable(rank_summary,digits=2);knitr::kable(rank_changes)
pd<-curves |> select(policy,period,equity_cny,drawdown_cny) |>
 pivot_longer(c(equity_cny,drawdown_cny),names_to='metric',values_to='CNY')
p1<-ggplot(pd,aes(period,CNY,colour=policy))+geom_line()+facet_wrap(~metric,ncol=1,scales='free_y')+
 theme_minimal()+labs(title='Signed handicap calibration and Top2 coverage: 390 outside-window issues',subtitle='CNY 1,024 cap; retrospective window; starting capital CNY 100,000',colour=NULL,x='Issue index')
print(p1);ggsave(file.path(o,'equity-drawdown.png'),p1,width=12,height=8,dpi=150)
p2<-ggplot(ranks |> filter(actual_legal),aes(actual_cost,colour=arm))+stat_ecdf()+scale_x_log10()+theme_minimal()+
 labs(title='Actual winning combination: required prefix cost',subtitle='Conditional on legal winning states; excluded third outcomes reported separately',x='CNY (log scale)',y='Fraction of groups covered',colour=NULL)
print(p2);ggsave(file.path(o,'winning-rank-cdf.png'),p2,width=11,height=6,dpi=150)
p3<-ggplot(probability$calibration |> filter(outcome=='D'),aes(predicted,observed,colour=model))+
 geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,linetype=2)+geom_line()+geom_point(aes(size=fixtures))+theme_minimal()+
 labs(title='Handicap draw calibration',x='Predicted probability',y='Observed draw frequency',colour=NULL)
print(p3);ggsave(file.path(o,'draw-calibration.png'),p3,width=10,height=6,dpi=150)
```

上述结果验证固定规则在回撤窗口外的表现。格子更新不保证让平只能上调；若历史支持下调，也应如实反映。
期命中增加不等于盈利增加，中奖组排名提前也必须与被挤出的原中奖票一起评价。
